name: Al Bateen Executive Airport

runway.v: one runway, 13/31, 3,202 m long and 45 m wide

hours.quote: A high-precision technical ecosystem operating 24/7 with zero slot restrictions and a 50-stand apron layout

slots.v: no slot restrictions, as stated by the operator
slots.quote: With no slot restrictions, no holding patterns, and short taxi times, AZI accommodates the demands

max_aircraft.v: aircraft up to code D (Boeing 767 size); up to 50 aircraft stands
max_aircraft.quote: Aircraft Category | Up to Code D, B767 equivalent ... Apron capacity | Up to 50 aircraft stands

handling.v: Jetex runs the FBO, opened in 2023
handling.quote: The Jetex FBO, opened in 2023, adds another layer of luxury.

ppr.v: aircraft larger than code 4D need prior approval from OMAD Operations; the AIP's local regulations (AD 2.20) state no other prior-permission rule
ppr.quote: Larger aircraft require prior approval from OMAD Operations.

fuel.v: Jet A by fuel truck; AVGAS 100 LL also listed

noise.v: Abu Dhabi Island (area OMR 66) is a noise abatement area: overflights below 2,000 ft are restricted 18:30-02:00 UTC (22:30-06:00 local, fixed UTC+4). This limits overflight, not the airport's night movements
noise.quote: The area OMR 66 (ABU DHABI ISLAND) is primarily a noise abatement area and restricted for over flights below 2000

missing: current-edition AD 2 OMAD (AIRAC 11/2026, effective 29 Oct 2026, not opened; values are from AIRAC 09/2026)
notes: All facts are from the operator's own websites (albateenairport.ae, adairports.ae); the UAE AIP AD 2 OMAD text could not be found or opened, so no AIP coordinates. Runway length is the operator's rounded '3.2km' (longest_m 3200 is therefore approximate). '24/7' is an operating-hours statement, not an explicit 'no night restriction', so curfew is left missing. The site lists 'Customs and immigration facilitation' only as a handling service, with no hours. Stand counts differ between sites (50 on albateenairport.ae, 54 on adairports.ae): only the 50 figure from the airport's own spec table is used.
